## Change

Describe the security capability or defect addressed.

## Validation

- [ ] `make validate`
- [ ] relevant Docker/VirtualBox flow
- [ ] positive and negative tests
- [ ] telemetry, threat model or risk context updated
- [ ] no credentials, customer data or live findings added

## Evidence

Link or describe the reproducible evidence generated by this change.

## Residual risk

Document known limitations, compensating controls and any expiry-bound acceptance.
